page_title: The Most Accurate Speech-To-Text API | Rev AI

sources.entry: 13. Rev.ai - Speech recognition and transcription API.

summary.name: Rev AI
summary.one_liner: Rev AI is a developer-focused speech-to-text API, part of the Rev family, that transcribes pre-recorded files and live audio streams in 57+ languages.
use_cases: Adding live captions to audio streams
Generating word-level timestamps for media search
Building voice analytics with sentiment or topics
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a speech-to-text API that returns machine-generated transcripts from pre-recorded files in minutes or in real time from audio streams, across 57+ languages with punctuation and formatting. It offers AI insights including language identification, sentiment analysis, topic extraction, summarization, and translation. It provides forced alignment for word-level timestamps. The page says it offers SDKs and cloud or on-prem deployment, with claims of SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI compliance and 99.99% uptime.
notable: Real-time streaming and pre-recorded file transcription via API
AI insights: sentiment, topics, summarization, translation
Claims of lowest word error rate, with proprietary models trained on over 7M hours of human-verified speech
caveats: Accuracy and bias claims (lowest WER, less bias) are vendor self-claims with no independent figures on the page
Pricing is not stated on the page
